news.title: Marvell agrees to buy Lumentum at a $115B enterprise value, one of the largest tech deals this year
news.text: Marvell Technology and Lumentum Holdings announced a combination implying a $115B enterprise value for Lumentum (about $1,132/share, ~24% above its unaffected 28 Oct price), aimed at building out AI-optics/connectivity capacity. Marvell expects over $1B in annual run-rate cost synergies. Neither ticker is on today's watchlist, but it is the dominant Technology-sector headline into the open.

news.title: Futures firmer into the open as Wall Street tries to extend its bounce from last week's tech selloff
news.text: Two live-market blogs dated today both describe US index futures higher pre-open, continuing a recovery from last week's sharp tech drawdown, with Apple's earnings report and Tuesday's midterm elections the next catalysts in view. Magnitudes differ enough between sources (roughly 0.3-0.9% across the three indices) that no single reconciled point figure is published here -- see the futures note above.
